title: Solar Irrigation Improves Ethiopian Farming Yields
reason: Describes the impact and innovations of the ILSI project on small-scale farmers in Ethiopia.

tasks.task: Describe the innovations in water-lifting and delivery systems used by the Ethiopian farmers.

subtasks.text: Observe the range of water-lifting methods, from manual to solar-powered pumps.
Note the cost-effectiveness and reliability of solar-powered pumps.
Highlight the farmer's experience and benefits from using solar pumps.

tasks.task: Explain the water conservation and yield improvements resulting from these innovations.

subtasks.text: Observe the practice of storing water from the winter season for use during the growing season.
Note the ability to increase maize production through efficient water use.

tasks.task: Describe the locally-made and maintained components of the irrigation systems.
